notes: Read only the assigned reader instructions and the ten assigned source strips. Visual reading order was p75, p79, p76, p77, p78. No OCR, canonical transcript, candidate stream, prior research, peer marks, or other scan was opened.

All coordinates are visual estimates in native upright 2040 by 2805 space. Bottom-strip coordinates have y offset 1322. Boxes are half-open. Baseline points are estimates of the lower edge of printed text and use ascending x.

Each visible article-body baseline was entered once. The overlapping strip rows on p75 and p78 were deduplicated. All whitespace-separated printed edge chunks preserve case and punctuation as visually read. Interior cues skip freestanding separators when needed to find a readable pair.
Paragraph starts were marked true when a new spaced text group was visually clear, false for evident continuations, and null for aligned sentence breaks whose paragraph status was unclear.

The centered all-caps five-line passage on p77 has an uncertain display role. It is included among body rows because the immediately following paragraph visibly introduces an explanation of that assertion. This is a source-role decision. The isolated repeated four-line passage embedded in the p78 illustration is excluded as a display quotation.

Artwork, running matter, page numbers and the final handwritten signature are separate exclusions. No readable folio was visible on p77. Some decorative marks have uncertain letterform roles, stated in the exclusions.

Four diagnostic crops were made with sips using crop-only operations and kept as PNG files under .reader-a-work. Their decoded RGB bytes were checked against the exact source rectangles and were pixel-identical. No resampling was performed. Native crop rectangles appear in diagnosticCrops.

Visible distress, scan smearing, warping, strikethrough, broad spaces, and edge separators are noted on affected rows. No uncertain letter was silently completed using another source. Apostrophes are represented by the ordinary apostrophe character and printed long separators were excluded when they stood alone at a line edge.
